title: Uniform vanishing of Ext between integral constructible sheaves
statement:
Work in the global finite-field setting of [sk-def-sf-setting]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ has characteristic $p\ne\ell$, $X$ is separated of finite type over $k$, and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\pi_E$. Use the completed integral coefficient sheaves and the categories $\Cons(-,\mathcal O_E)$ of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Let $a=i\circ u:S\hookrightarrow Z\hookrightarrow X$ and $L$ be as in [det-lem-int-ext-formula](1): $i$ is closed, $u$ is open, and $L\in\Cons(S,\mathcal O_E)$ is pro-étale locally the completion of a finitely generated $\mathcal O_E$-module, possibly with torsion. Let $j:X\setminus Z\hookrightarrow X$ be the open complement of $i$, and use the cohomological dimensions of [sk-def-cd]. Then
$$
\Ext^r_X(a_!L,N)=0\qquad\text{for }r>\operatorname{cd}_\ell(j)+\operatorname{cd}_\ell(S)+3
\quad\text{and every }N\in\Cons(X,\mathcal O_E).
$$
Here $\Ext^r_X(A,N)=\operatorname{Hom}_{D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E)}(A,N[r])$.
Consequently every $C\in\Cons(X,\mathcal O_E)$ has an integer $d_C\ge0$ with $\Ext^r_X(C,N)=0$ for $r>d_C$ and every $N\in\Cons(X,\mathcal O_E)$.

proof.text: As in the original step 1, finite-type finiteness over the algebraically closed base gives c=cd_l(j) and s=cd_l(S) as natural numbers. Give Z,S,V their induced base structures; Noetherianity supplies the quasi-compactness needed by the finite-type dimension lemmas.

The finite-reduction estimate [lem-sf-integral-stratum-reduction-ext-bound] gives Hom(a_!L,N_n[r])=0 for r>c+s+2 for every positive actual derived reduction of a constructible N. The reconstruction lemma [lem-sf-integral-constructible-reduction-limit] supplies a product and a Roos derived-limit triangle for those levels and N[0].

Write P=product N_n. Shift preserves products, so projections detect maps a_!L -> P[r]. The finite-level estimate kills all their projections in degrees r-1 and r when r>c+s+3. Shift the Roos triangle by r-1 and apply Hom exactness: a map a_!L -> N[r] factors through P[r-1], hence is zero. This proves the first clause, with d=c+s+3 and the displayed equality in WithTop N. No support inverse image is commuted with the inverse limit.

Place C in degree zero; its sole nonzero cohomology is C, so it is bounded constructible. Apply [det-lem-int-ext-formula](1) to obtain its finite triangle filtration. The concentration-in-degree-zero condition removes every shift. A locally closed stratum in Noetherian X is qcqs, and the complement of its closed tail is a quasi-compact open immersion, so the first clause bounds each stratum piece uniformly in N.

Induct over the filtration. The zero starting vertex has no nonzero maps. At each distinguished triangle take the maximum of the nonnegative bounds for the first and third vertices. The contravariant Hom exact sequence factors any middle-source morphism through the third vertex when its restriction to the first is zero; both vanish beyond the maximum. Finally transport the bound along the terminal filtration isomorphism. Empty filtrations and zero objects have bound zero.

proof_origin.place: paragraphs (2) and final filtration paragraph; T1 formalizes the Roos and filtration arguments and isolates the finite-reduction and reconstruction steps

split_report.summary: Twelve-step proof of both the numerical stratum bound and its finite-filtration consequent, retaining the completed coefficient categories and possibly torsion stratum modules. Uses existing statements for derived completeness, finite-coefficient comparison, local finite-free resolutions, support fibres, Tor amplitude, sections, and the Roos triangle. The repaired coefficient comparison and bounded-input amplitude arguments now explicitly cite lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction and lem-pur-bounded-heart-amplitude. The original ordinary-dual blueprint error is documented by its torsion-point counterexample; the current formula node already uses the correct derived dual. Verified all 57 citation pairs against current statements and all tool hypotheses. No new nodes, Lean edits or compiler invocations.

The erroneous ordinary cHom in unit paragraph 1 is replaced by the derived dual already stated in det-lem-int-integral-heart-dualizable; the reduction tower, support bound, Tor bound, sections bound, and one-degree Milnor loss are unchanged.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q153-becf9d93a (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the delivery in full: 1 commit with the item and its report, no new nodes, proof_deps equal to the union of the 12 steps' uses (39 ids, none missing or merged), no SGA. Statement: both clauses and the bound cd(j)+cd(S)+3 are kept, torsion L is allowed, and the completed coefficient B=O_{E,X} is kept separate from the finite A_n throughout. The explicit k=F̄_q setting is the one the only citer, sk-lem-int-ext, already uses through sk-def-sf-setting, so nothing is weakened. Source error confirmed: the blueprint's ordinary dual cHom(L,O) fails for L=O_E/π on a point, where Hom=0 but Ext^1=O_E/π. The split uses the derived dual instead, which matches the corrected det-lem-int-ext-formula(2). Sources read: Bhatt–Scholze Def 6.5.1 and Lemmas 6.5.3–6.5.4, Stacks 099M, 093M and 08JJ, and the 08TC/08TB derived limit; I checked all cited tags against tags/tags. The blueprint's 099Q is mislabeled, and the steps correctly use 099M. Steps: (1) cd finite by 0F10. (2) Derived completeness, reductions and étale origin. (3) N_n=[N→N] in [-1,0], killed by ℓ^n. (4) Formula through i_*⊣RΓ_Z (O_E is admissible) and u_!⊣u^*. (5) D_n has a finite constant local model from the DVR and Smith normal form, so it is constructible and classical. (6) Res commutes with Rj_* via ring-sheaf-change-adjunction; the coefficient square commutes. (7) Rj_*j^*N_n lies in [-1,c] by the heart-amplitude lemma. (8) The fibre lies in [-1,c+1] and is classical. (9) T_n lies in [-1,c+2] and is classical, using Tor reflection. (10) Sections bound c+s+2, through the chain of module/abelian and pro-étale/étale comparisons, with the B-to-A_n change of rings by the scalar-extension adjunction. (11) Hom into the Roos triangle, clause (iii), loses one degree: c+s+3. (12) The filtration induction gives d_C, with d_0=0. Edge cases: S=∅, Z=X, L=O_E or O_E/π on a point, torsion N, C=0. Duplicate search: the sk-lem-uniform-constructible-ext and det-uniform-constructible-ext-* nodes have different statements. I accept all 27 declared tool_uses as generic tools. No fixes. Minor, not faults: source.external still lists 099Q, and step 4 re-derives the sibling formula instead of citing it.
